{{recipe}}

Originally posted to Foodista by Anne Pedersen. Foodista recipes are released under a CC-BY license.

==Ingredients==
*⅓ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (45 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Coconut oil|coconut oil]]
*¼ cup (25 g) unsweetened [[Cookbook:Cocoa Powder|cocoa powder]]
*⅛ cup + 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] (30 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] + 1 tsp) [[Cookbook:Maple Syrup|maple syrup]] 
*1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]

==Preparation==
#Melt the coconut oil in a small [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] over low heat. Once melted, transfer to a bowl and [[Cookbook:Whisk|whisk]] in unsweetened cacao powder, maple syrup, and salt until smooth and lump-free.
#Pour the chocolate mix into small chocolate molds. You can also use a regular baking tray.
#Place them in the freezer/fridge to harden for a few hours. If using a regular baking tray, cut the chocolate into pieces with a sharp [[Cookbook:Knife|knife]].

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Because these confections are not made of [[Cookbook:Tempering Chocolate|tempered chocolate]], they will not hold their shape at room temperature. They must be stored in the fridge or freezer.
